summary: PARTIAL is right for web and desktop. 65af92766 registers the saved connection right after the session check and renewal, so thread subscriptions attach before the ws-token, upgrade and config. It also removed the second device socket and ws-token from connect. The web and desktop connect still does GET /api/auth/session and then POST /api/auth/ws-token, two sequential round trips. The auditor missed that mobile already removed that round trip in #710 (60633eff3) without a server change: a cached session hint (apps/mobile/src/connection/savedSessionHints.ts) lets a connect whose session is not due skip the pre-socket session GET, and the check runs in the background after register. Web and desktop never adopted it, so the remaining work is to move that mechanism into client-runtime and wire it into apps/web, not a new prefetch or server endpoint. A smaller leftover the auditor also missed: an SSH saved environment's first connect runs the SSH ensure (ssh -G subprocess plus a tunnel HTTP readiness probe) twice in a row.

evidence.note: registerConnection(connection) runs after the session check (1463) and renewal (1487), before refreshSavedEnvironmentMetadata (1629). Added in 65af92766 with a test in service.addSavedEnvironment.test.ts ('registers a connect before its config arrives...').
register() attaches every pending thread-detail subscription for the environment (812-814), so attach() (540) no longer waits for config or metadata.

The saved client's dedicated /ws/device socket (with its own ws-token) opens only on demand through openDedicated (65af92766). The finding's 'plus the device socket's own ws-token and socket' cost is gone from connect.
Web still awaits GET /api/auth/session (readSavedEnvironmentSession at 1190) on every connect and reconnect attempt, before any socket. No hint or skip path.

The WsTransport URL provider then reads the bearer and POSTs /api/auth/ws-token (resolveSavedEnvironmentSocketUrl 1012, resolveRemoteWebSocketConnectionUrl at 1033 -> packages/client-runtime/src/connection/remoteApi.ts:151-168). Second sequential RTT before the upgrade.

Missed by the auditor. usableSavedSessionHint plus createSavedSessionHints (added in 60633eff3 / #710) persist non-secret session metadata. A connect whose session is bearer-method, more than 1 h from expiry and not due for renewal skips GET /api/auth/session and goes straight to ws-token, which answers an expired or revoked bearer with a terminal 401.

Mobile connect uses hintedSession instead of the session check, registers, then runs the skipped check in the background (about 535-570). A rejection calls rejectCredential and removes the connection by identity. Mobile registers without waiting for config. Web has nothing like this; git grep for sessionHint outside apps/mobile finds nothing.
The ws-token route still returns only {token, expiresAt} (contracts auth.ts:131). There is no combined session+ws-token endpoint. Mobile shows one is not needed.
The ws-token prefetch alongside the session check (65af92766) applies only to the primary environment.

For desktop SSH environments, the URL provider calls prepareSavedEnvironmentRecordForConnection again right after connectSavedEnvironment did at 1455. Each call is an IPC ensureEnvironment that runs ssh -G (packages/ssh/src/tunnel.ts:1525) and a readiness probe through the tunnel (tunnel.ts:1456). The first connect pays it twice. This was the same at f1be4abc7.
SAVED_ENVIRONMENT_CONFIG_SNAPSHOT_WAIT_MS is now 1000 ms. The snapshot-then-getConfig race no longer gates thread attach but still gates the connect promise.

waitForPrimaryShellSnapshotApplied(2500) is unchanged and deliberate. The saved connect queue runs at concurrency 2 (supervision.ts:61; savedEnvironmentConnectionScheduler.ts:44 awaits each connect), so a slot is held until config arrives.

remaining: Web and desktop direct pairings still pay two sequential HTTP round trips before the WS upgrade on every connect and reconnect: GET /api/auth/session (apps/web/src/environments/runtime/service.ts:1463 via readSavedEnvironmentSession at 1190), then POST /api/auth/ws-token from the URL provider (service.ts:1091 -> 1012-1043 -> packages/client-runtime/src/connection/remoteApi.ts:151-168). Mobile already skips the first one with cached session hints (apps/mobile/src/connection/savedSessionHints.ts, environmentDriver.ts:434-570), but that code lives only in apps/mobile. The shared runtime and web never got it, which also splits saved-session auth policy between mobile and web, against the AGENTS.md rule that auth and lifecycle policy stays shared. Minor leftovers: (1) a desktop SSH environment's first connect runs ensureEnvironment twice back to back (service.ts:1455, then the URL provider at service.ts:1025), each an ssh -G subprocess plus a tunnel readiness probe (packages/ssh/src/tunnel.ts:1525, 1456); (2) the connect promise, and so one of the two queue slots (supervision.ts:61), is held until the config snapshot or a getConfig fallback after 1000 ms (savedEnvironmentSession.ts:25), which delays the third and later saved environments slightly.
fixDefects: None found in the early-registration fix. After registration, an auth failure (credentialRejection or ws-token 401) goes through markSavedEnvironmentCredentialRejected or setRuntimeRequiresAuth. Any other failure (config timeout, network) reaches discardConnection (service.ts:1599-1613), which removes by identity and detaches the subscriptions it attached early. The desktop SSH reissue path discards before continuing. This is covered by the new test in service.addSavedEnvironment.test.ts.
implementationSketch:
Port the mobile session-hint skip to the shared runtime and use it on web and desktop for non-SSH direct pairings.
1. Move apps/mobile/src/connection/savedSessionHints.ts and its .test.ts into packages/client-runtime/src/connection/ (it depends only on @ryco/contracts, shouldRenewSavedSession and KVService) and export it from the connection subpath. Mobile imports it from there with no behaviour change.
2. In apps/web/src/environments/runtime/service.ts, create one hints instance with createWebKV() (apps/web/src/platform/kv.ts). In connectSavedEnvironment, for records without desktopSsh, read the hint alongside the bearer read. If usableSavedSessionHint(hint, Date.now()) returns a session, use it as `session`, skip readSavedEnvironmentSession, and let savedSessionRenewal.renew no-op (a usable hint is never due). Otherwise keep today's check and record renewal.session afterwards, unless the attempt was cancelled. Pass that session to refreshSavedEnvironmentMetadata so it does not re-read.
3. After registerConnection on a hinted connect, run the skipped check in the background with the currently stored bearer (savedSessionRenewal.readBearerToken), the same way environmentDriver.ts does at about 535-570. If it answers null or 401 while the connection is still current, call markSavedEnvironmentCredentialRejected(environmentId, connection) and forget the hint. On success, record the hint, patch role, and restart keepSavedEnvironmentSessionRenewed with the fresh session.
4. Forget the hint wherever web marks requires-auth (setRuntimeRequiresAuth, markSavedEnvironmentCredentialRejected, the onCredentialRejected callback), when the environment is paired again (addSavedEnvironment), and when it is removed. The ws-token 401 path already ends terminally through isTerminalUrlError -> onCredentialRejected -> credentialRejection -> SavedEnvironmentCredentialError in refreshSavedEnvironmentMetadata.
5. Optionally, for SSH: skip the URL provider's ensure on the first socket attempt right after connectSavedEnvironment prepared the record. For example, pass the prepared record or a prepared-at timestamp into createSavedEnvironmentClient and bypass the ensure when it is under a few seconds old. Reconnects keep ensuring. Optionally, release the connect-queue slot once registered instead of after config.
Tests: service.savedEnvironments.test.ts and service.addSavedEnvironment.test.ts cases for (a) a hinted connect issues no /api/auth/session before /api/auth/ws-token; (b) a renewal-due or near-expiry hint keeps the check; (c) a ws-token 401 on a hinted connect marks requires-auth, forgets the hint and removes the connection by identity; (d) a background check answering unauthenticated removes the registered connection; (e) SSH records ignore hints; (f) a cancelled attempt does not record a hint. The moved client-runtime unit test covers the hint store. Run focused vitest for apps/web runtime, packages/client-runtime connection and apps/mobile connection.
decisionReason: This changes the web and desktop saved-pairing auth flow: the credential would be validated by the ws-token request instead of a pre-socket session check, and non-secret session metadata (role, expiry, auth descriptor) would persist in browser localStorage. Mobile already shipped this pattern in #710, so it is a small, precedented decision, but it is still an auth-semantics change and should be approved explicitly. Moving it into client-runtime also fixes the mobile-only fork of saved-session auth policy that AGENTS.md says to avoid.
correction: The status stays PARTIAL, but two points are wrong or incomplete. (1) 'The 1-RTT saving from the proposal's first item is not done' holds only for web and desktop. Mobile removed that round trip in 60633eff3 (#710) with a client-only cached session hint and a background check (apps/mobile/src/connection/savedSessionHints.ts, environmentDriver.ts:434). The remaining work is to share and adopt that mechanism, not build a new ws-token prefetch or a server endpoint with a version fallback. (2) The auditor did not credit 65af92766 with removing the device socket's separate ws-token and socket from connect (service.ts:1164, now on demand), and did not note the SSH double ensure (service.ts:1455 and 1025).
